scope: Full actual head STL and full actual cap STL independently; no head-cap assembly intersection test is performed.
shared_vertex_policy: Any pair sharing any exactly identical vertex coordinate is excluded; therefore adjacent-facet overlap away from shared vertices is not certified by this test. Duplicate facets and degenerate facets are counted separately.
method: Axis sweep of all triangle AABBs, full 3-axis AABB overlap, exact shared-vertex exclusion, triangle-plane separation, then triangle-plane interval intersection with projected polygon rejection. Strict transverse crossing and coplanar area overlap are reported separately from near-plane/coplanar numerical contacts.

head.stl_vertex_indexing: Exact float32 coordinate equality; no tolerance merging or geometry processing. Triangle indices remain actual binary STL facet order.

cap.stl_vertex_indexing: Exact float32 coordinate equality; no tolerance merging or geometry processing. Triangle indices remain actual binary STL facet order.
